messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "not expected to produce life-threatening symptoms"
set: ["not expected to produce life-threatening symptoms", "single large dose not likely to cause life-threatening symptoms", "not expected to harm an unborn baby", "pancreas to produce more", "liver to produce cholesterol", "can produce symptoms of an overactive thyroid", "may cause life-threatening withdrawal symptoms in newborn", "life-threatening if not recognized and treated", "life-threatening ketoacidosis", "symptoms usually not serious", "life-threatening breathing problems", "does not cause withdrawal symptoms", "rare and life-threatening complication", "severe or life-threatening bleeding", "symptoms may not improve for up to 2 to 6 weeks", "symptoms may not improve for up to 4 weeks"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
